Looking at the cuboid (4×2×2 = 16 cubes), I can track each colour:

- **Dark grey piece:** the left end – top front, top back, bottom front left, and bottom front second cube (4 cubes, complete).
- **Light grey piece:** the three top front cubes plus the bottom front cube at position 3 (4 cubes, complete).
- **Black piece:** the right end – top back, bottom front, bottom back, plus the hidden bottom back cube at position 3 (4 cubes, complete).
- **White piece:** the two visible top back cubes (positions 2 and 3) plus the two hidden bottom back cubes (positions 1 and 2).

So the white piece consists of a row of two cubes on top (positions 2–3) and a row of two cubes on the bottom (positions 1–2), offset by one – a flat "S/Z" (skew) shape in a vertical plane.

Checking the options: this skew shape (top pair offset right relative to bottom pair, all in one plane) matches option **C**.

\boxed{C}
